import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the catplot to visualize survival rate by Pclass and Sex
# 'kind="bar"' automatically calculates the mean of 'survived' for each group
g = sns.catplot(
    x='pclass', 
    y='survived', 
    hue='sex', 
    data=df, 
    kind='bar', 
    palette='viridis', 
    height=5, 
    aspect=1.2,
    errorbar=('ci', 95) # Show 95% confidence interval
)

# Set titles and labels
g.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Rate")
g.fig.suptitle('Survival Rate on Titanic by Passenger Class and Sex', y=1.03) # y adjusts title position
g._legend.set_title("Sex")

# Improve x-axis labels for Pclass if desired (optional)
# g.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third']) # requires setting x-axis ticks manually if 'pclass' is int

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
